title: CI refuses a merge when a secret is past its rotation budget
asA: operator who set a rotation policy expecting it to hold
iWant: CI to fail a change when a secret has aged past its rotation-days budget

acceptanceCriteria.description: The rotation gate compares each manifest entry's `rotationDays` against the vendor-reported `lastRotatedAt`; an entry with elapsed days greater than `rotationDays` fails the run with a stable-coded error naming the entry, environment, `lastRotatedAt`, and elapsed days.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest entry `S` with `rotationDays: 90` and a vendor-reported `lastRotatedAt` 120 days before the CI-run wall clock
acceptanceCriteria.when: the rotation gate runs in CI
acceptanceCriteria.then: CI fails with `SECRETS_ROTATION_EXPIRED` naming `S`, the environment, the `lastRotatedAt` value, and the number `120`

acceptanceCriteria.description: A required entry with no vendor-reported `lastRotatedAt` fails the gate; an optional entry with no `lastRotatedAt` fails the gate.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest entry `S` where the vendor returns no `lastRotatedAt` field for the active environment path
acceptanceCriteria.then: CI fails with `SECRETS_ROTATION_UNKNOWN` naming `S` and the environment, whether `required` is true or false

acceptanceCriteria.description: An operator-authored override file with an expiry timestamp is honoured for a named entry until the expiry passes; the gate audits the override every time it applies.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an override file naming entry `S` with an expiry six hours in the future
acceptanceCriteria.when: the rotation gate runs against `S` past its rotation budget
acceptanceCriteria.then: the run does not fail on `S`, and a `SECRETS_ROTATION_OVERRIDE_APPLIED` audit event is emitted naming `S`, the override author, the override expiry, and the wall-clock at gate time
